PUNJAB PLACE OF PROVISION OF
SERVICES RULES, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th April, 2023]
No.
PRA/Orders.06/2021/293, dated 13.4.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 76 of the Punjab Sales
Tax on Services Act, 2012 (XLII of 2012), the Punjab Revenue Authority, with
the approval of Government, is pleased to prescribe the following rules in
relation to determination of place of provision of the taxable services
specified in these rules:
1. Short
title, extent, application and commencement.---(1) These rules shall be cited as the Punjab Place of Provision of
Services Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall extend to the whole of Province of Punjab and shall apply in case of the
taxable services, as are specified in these rules and are provided or rendered
or received in the Province of Punjab.
(3) They
shall take effect on and from the 1st day of May, 2023 except Electric Power
Transmission Lines Services as mentioned in rule 9 of the rules, which shall
take effect from the 1st day of July, 2023.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant to the subject or context:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012;
(b) "Authority"
means the Punjab Revenue Authority (abbreviated as PRA) established under
section 3 of the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012 (XLIII of 2012);
(c) "Broadcast
Station" shall have the meaning as given in clause (ca) of section 2 of
the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance
No. XIII of 2002);
(d) "Channel",
in relation to broadcasting, shall have the meaning as given in clause (f) of
section 2 of the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
(Ordinance No. XIII of 2002);
(e) "Distribution
Services", for the purposes of the services of advertisements on TV, shall
have the meaning as given in clause (ha) of section 2 of the Pakistan
Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance No. XIII of
2002);
(f) "PEMRA"
means the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority established under
section 3 of Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
(Ordinance No. XIII of 2002);
(g) "Province"
or "Provinces" means the Provinces and the Islamabad Capital
Territory as specified in clause (2) of Article 1 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan;
(h) "Provision
of Service" shall have the meaning as given in subsection (5) of section 3
of the Act;
(i) "rules"
means the Punjab Place of Provision of Services Rules, 2023;
(j) "Specified
Services" means the services of:
(i) "Advertisement"
as specified in Entries Nos. 2, 5 and 12 (Classification Heading 98.02 and the
sub-heads thereof) in the Second Schedule to the Act;
(ii) "Advertising
agents" as specified in Entry No. 29 (Classification Heading 9805.7000) in
the Second Schedule to the Act;
(iii) "Insurance"
as specified in Entry No. 7 (Classification Heading 98.13 and the sub-headings
thereof) in the Second Schedule to the Act;
(iv) "Insurance
Agents" as specified in Entry No. 7 (Classification Heading 9831.0000) in
the Second Schedule to the Act;
(v) "Franchise"
and "Intellectual property" and "Licensing" as specified in
Entry No. 13 (Classification Headings 9823.0000 and 9839.0000, and respective
headings, respectively) in the Second Schedule to the Act; and
(vi) "Transportation
or carriage of goods by road or services in relation to transport of goods
other than water, through pipeline, conduit or any other medium" as
specified in Entry Nos. 47 and 48 (Classification Heading 9804.2000, 9804.9000
and respective headings) in the Second Schedule to the Act; and
(vii) "Electric
power transmission lines services" as specified in Entry No. 47 in the
Second Schedule to the Act; and
(k) "Uplinking"
shall have the meaning as given in clause (w) of section 2 of the Pakistan
Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 (Ordinance No. XIII of
2002).
